content.value_statement: AI news changes quickly, and users need current updates from credible sources. This skill searches public AI sources, filters duplicates, and returns categorized briefs with links.
actual_capabilities: Fetches public AI news pages and full articles with webReader when available.
Runs date-filtered web searches for daily, weekly, and topic-specific AI updates.
Filters stale, duplicate, minor, and unrelated stories before summarizing results.
Categorizes stories into announcements, research, business, tools, policy, and ethics.
Formats briefs with source names, publication dates, links, key points, impact, and takeaways.
limitations: Requires web access and depends on source availability.
May miss stories from paywalled, blocked, or slow websites.
Does not verify claims beyond the fetched source material.
Needs current date filters to avoid stale search results.

use_cases.title: Scan Market Changes
use_cases.description: Get a concise daily view of major AI product launches, model releases, and company announcements.

use_cases.title: Monitor Research Signals
use_cases.description: Follow recent papers, benchmark results, and technical breakthroughs without reading every source manually.

use_cases.title: Track Business Moves
use_cases.description: Review AI funding rounds, partnerships, acquisitions, and market shifts with links to original coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Daily Briefing
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a broad update.
prompt_templates.prompt: Give me today's AI news briefing. Include major announcements, research, business, tools, and policy stories with source links.

prompt_templates.title: Focused Category Update
prompt_templates.scenario: Narrow the briefing to one topic area.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show only AI research and model release news from the last 48 hours. Include publication dates and links.

prompt_templates.title: Company Watch
prompt_templates.scenario: Track selected organizations across recent news.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find this week's AI news about OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Microsoft, and Meta. Group results by company.

prompt_templates.title: Executive Digest
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an executive AI news digest for the last 48 hours. Prioritize primary sources, note duplicate coverage, and explain business impact.

output: A categorized briefing with major announcements, research, business, tools, and policy sections.
Each story includes a short summary, key points, impact, publication date, source name, and link.
The response ends with three key takeaways from the day.

output_examples.input: Only show AI research updates from this week.
output: A research-focused roundup of recent papers, benchmark results, and technical breakthroughs.
The skill excludes funding, product, and policy stories unless they directly affect research.
Each item includes the source, date, link, and a concise impact note.

output_examples.input: Tell me more about this funding story.
output: A deeper summary of the selected article, including company context and why the deal matters.
The response can include related coverage and comparable funding events when sources are available.

best_practices: Ask for a time range so searches use fresh date filters.
Request source links when the briefing will support decisions.
Specify focus areas when you need research, business, tools, or policy coverage.
anti_patterns: Do not treat article summaries as verified facts without checking original sources.
Do not request private or paywalled content that the available tools cannot access.
Do not use broad prompts when you need coverage of a specific company or topic.

faq.question: Does this skill browse the web?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed to use public web sources and web search for current AI news.

faq.question: Can it create a weekly AI news summary?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask for a weekly summary, and it adjusts date filters and grouping.

faq.question: Does it include links to sources?
faq.answer: Yes. The recommended output includes source names, dates, and direct article links.

faq.question: Can I focus on only research papers?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask for research-only coverage to filter out business and product stories.

faq.question: Will it summarize paywalled articles?
faq.answer: It can use available excerpts, but it should note when full content is unavailable.

faq.question: Is this a fact-checking skill?
faq.answer: No. It summarizes available sources and should cite links for user verification.
